scoring_justification: Headline results are three composite SRL scores; recomputing from raw artifacts infeasible because the only artifacts are the final numbers. The checker compares each to the paper-reported gold values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the three composite SRL scores.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values from the text: ACCC subsystem SRL=0.28, nested system SRL=0.51, un-nested system SRL=0.42.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from paper's narrative and figures (Section IV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact results reported in the paper (Table I, Figure 5, Figure 6, Figure 7), directly extracted for comparison.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the composite SRL score for the ACCC subsystem.

outputs.description: Composite SRL score for the ACCC subsystem computed from the provided digraph and TRL/IRL data.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the composite SRL score for the nested power plant system.

outputs.description: Composite SRL score for the advanced power plant system with the ACCC subsystem nested as a single component.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the composite SRL score for the un-nested power plant system.

outputs.description: Composite SRL score for the advanced power plant system with ACCC components kept separate (un-nested).

output_contract.notes: All three composite SRL scores are computed using the same matrix normalization formula with provided digraph data and the SRL Translation Table. The checker compares each value to the paper's reported hidden gold with an appropriate tolerance.
